findings.title: Missing security header: strict-transport-security
findings.recommendation: Add `strict-transport-security` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Missing security header: content-security-policy
findings.recommendation: Add `content-security-policy` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Missing HSTS
findings.recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload after verifying every subdomain is HTTPS-only.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.recommendation: Ship a nonce-based CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-<N>'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'.

findings.title: Legacy TLS version accepted
findings.recommendation: Disable TLS < 1.2 at the edge (Caddy: `tls { protocols tls1.2 tls1.3 }`).

findings.title: Missing security header: x-frame-options
findings.recommendation: Add `x-frame-options` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Missing security header: x-content-type-options
findings.recommendation: Add `x-content-type-options` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Missing security header: referrer-policy
findings.recommendation: Add `referrer-policy` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Missing security header: permissions-policy
findings.recommendation: Add `permissions-policy` at edge (Caddy/Next config).

findings.title: Framework fingerprinting via X-Powered-By
findings.recommendation: Strip banner (poweredByHeader:false in next.config.js).

findings.title: Form on /projects has no visible CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form action= method=POST. Framework may use SameSite/double-submit; needs verification. See reports/2026-08-21-testforge-emha-space-run2/evidence/projects/route-1.html
findings.recommendation: Verify CSRF protection: SameSite=Strict on session cookie AND server-side origin check, or explicit CSRF token.

findings.title: Missing clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options)
findings.recommendation: Prefer CSP frame-ancestors 'none'; or X-Frame-Options: DENY.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff globally.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.recommendation: Add Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.recommendation: Deny unused features, e.g. Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=().

findings.title: robots.txt enumerates sensitive routes
findings.recommendation: Do not enumerate protected paths in robots.txt. Rely on server-side auth; use noindex on individual pages.

findings.title: Missing /.well-known/security.txt
findings.recommendation: Publish security.txt per RFC 9116 (Contact, Expires, Preferred-Languages).

findings.title: HTTPS enforced from plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Maintain. Combine with HSTS to close first-visit downgrade window.
